mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, actor_id, module, action, target_type, target_id, detail_json) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{module}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detailJson})
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN al.action IN ('DELETE', 'FORCE_PUBLISH', 'ROLE_CHANGE') THEN 'high' WHEN al.action IN ('UPDATE', 'REJECT', 'RETRY') THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END
mapper.select:
SELECT al.id, al.tenant_id, al.actor_id, al.module, al.action, al.target_type, al.target_id, al.detail_json, al.gmt_create, AS risk_level FROM audit_log al
ORDER BY al.gmt_create DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
